notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary multi-attribute Request Attribute Value Update and provider response. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies provider callback attribute projection and request-tag propagation for a full request and selective first-only and second-only requests, response values and tags through ordinary Update Attribute Values, producing-federate and transportation metadata, suppression before the provider responds, owner loopback exclusion, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object publication, registration, attribute-value request, and ordinary update services with FederateAmbassador discovery, provider-response, and reflection callbacks for full and selective attribute sets
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-attribute declaration/request/update declarations and FederateAmbassador discovery/provider-response/reflection declarations
